facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Abilities 218/219/220/222 select condition group 402, whose row 104 refers to condition row 13 (type 601, Kappa). IsSelectableCommand at RVA 0x76a800 compares actor condition row IDs against both ability and command groups. Command 26 selects group 302, also row 13. Silence row 6 does not intersect these Magitek restrictions. This is actor eligibility, not an alive-target predicate; complete Kappa behavior is not implemented.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ability 222 selects function group 431: Recovery(2,2,0) followed by Unique(0,0,0), with process_prog None. Unique is not a status-removal function. The native FF6 provider selects calculated HP recovery; status/target overrides and full runtime parity are separate dependencies.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: FFVI's EnemyCharacterParameter constructor uses monster.ability_attack, not monster.magic. Monster 1 therefore supplies base magic 6; temporary values and the final cap are separate. This does not establish an enemy magic action or AI branch.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v4 executes the admitted silence behavior and source ability 389/763 add/recovery in controlled BattleGame setups. Ability and command restrictions share identity-based checks; other active behaviors remain blocked. This does not grant story abilities or establish full status, enemy AI, equipment, death/revival or original-game parity.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v5 uses shared neutral magic arithmetic for the existing beams and calculated recovery. Source flag identities, hit/variance draw order, enemy factor, defense and caps are checked. 83 source records have controlled scalar probes, not full spell support. Browser recovery, beams, victory and field return passed; statuses, affinities, accessories, full AI and original parity remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v6 replaces the provisional enemy physical formula and supports player selected-arm parameters, strength, physical variance-before-hit, integer multiply and ordinary critical draws. Source abilities 1/399 pass controlled BattleGame actions; 181 candidates have isolated scalar checks. Browser enemy attacks, evasion, recovery, beams, victory and field return passed. No new story command, region, AI, numerical status, equipment effect or original-parity claim.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v7 shares typed single/side/all requests, impact-time target selection, per-target effects, one action cost and rollback of numerical state and RNG on a later target failure. Source ability 345 passes controlled one/two-target actions and browser UI with independent 41/46 damage. Position groups, death/revival eligibility, reflection, confusion, full AI and original parity remain incomplete. No new story command or region is unlocked.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v8 uses explicit elemental inputs, physical priority and ordered magic calculations, separate immune results and signed absorption. Monster 26 fire weakness is projected into the existing opening catalog. Source fire beam 218 passes controlled browser immunity and absorption with HP 2000 to 2181. Unknown carriers 743/754/757 and conflicting resistance groups 81/125 remain blocked. Full statuses, dynamic affinities, equipment lifecycle, AI, saves and original parity remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v9 shares HP-zero death identity, dying threshold, player revival, cancellation of charged actions and post-battle status persistence. Source abilities 34/35 pass 16 controlled boundary and frame-partition checks. Browser Raise restores player:31 from 0/80 to 10/80 HP, clears death, retains dying and resets ATB. Enemy revival AI/rewards, undead, automatic revival, full scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new story unlock or region.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v10 replaces Guard/Silver Lobo templates with source-addressed normal AI control flow, conditional jumps, action-table cycles and per-enemy state. Normal decisions share the action queue and roll back AI state and RNG on target failure. 430 source scripts have diagnostics; 156 fully decoded normal programs are not playable-enemy coverage. Three additional source AI scripts pass controlled-host replay; existing five encounters and browser opening victory/field return pass. Ability 696, counters, interrupts, variables, full targeting/scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new story region.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v11 adds independently owned 15-cell enemy variables, separate mode, current HP/MP branches and transactional AI initialization/turn decisions. 430 source scripts are diagnosed; 165 fully decoded normal programs are not playable-enemy coverage. Five source AI programs pass controlled-host replay; constructed Soul Saver and Lesser Lopros checkpoints test variable/MP control flow without executing missing abilities. 239 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, existing five encounters, field arithmetic regression and browser opening victory/return pass. LoopAct, reactions/interrupts, ability/event parameter writers, complete scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new story region.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v12 adds source LoopAct repeats as one action-table turn, atomic group admission, per-action cost/target rechecks and gauge release after the last pending normal action. All 97 source LoopAct instructions pass isolated decoding/selection checks; two original instructions run in explicitly synthetic normal tables and replay across frame partitions. Their full enemy programs remain blocked on unimplemented triggers. 249 TypeScript and 18 Python tests and the existing five encounters pass. Browser controlled actions 462,1,1 retain ATB 100 after the first two actions and release it after the third. Browser opening victory, field return and movement also pass. Counter/final triggers, complete scheduling, dynamic abilities, global party/inventory/save and original parity remain incomplete. No new region or story unlock.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v13 adds primary-result reaction classification, source CounterAct, priority FIFO and atomic effect/AI/reaction commits. Counters preserve pending normal actions and gauges; self actions and counter chains do not trigger ordinary counters. All 233 source CounterAct instructions pass isolated decoding/selection checks, with two original instructions in explicitly synthetic hosts; full Templar and Tonberry programs remain blocked. 207 fully decoded AI programs are not playable-enemy coverage. 262 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, existing five encounters and browser opening victory/field return pass. Browser controlled actions 1,379,1 preserve enemy ATB 100 through its counter and release it after its normal action. Counter count one adopts a native constructor default in the bounded host; effective original deserialization is unverified. Final/recovery-special triggers, complete scheduling, dynamic abilities, global party/inventory/save and original parity remain incomplete. No new region or story unlock.
